name: Kuki Climate
description: Kuki Climate — a landing theme for a commercial HVAC maintenance contractor. An iron frame holds a dimmed documentary rooftop photograph with a huge light title and a twelve-month year line of visit dots; an iron card rides over the pinned window on scroll. Numbered ledger rows carry flat grey and sand panels with thin double chevrons, a pill toggle swaps quarterly and monthly visits on a grey band, and a timed list shows how the survey hour is spent. Manrope and Source Sans 3.
